data.desc: Advanced Biomed Inc. is a Nevada corporation specializing in innovative biomedical technologies for cancer detection and precision medicine. Operating through the subsidiary in Taiwan, the Company has developed a proprietary microfluidic platform that integrates semiconductor and biotechnology to enable advanced circulating tumor cell (CTC) detection, enrichment, and analysis. Its portfolio includes devices, biochips, and designed for cancer screening, diagnosis, treatment selection, and prognosis assessment, with regulatory clearances in progress in Taiwan and plans for future global expansion.
